summary: The CPCB methodology does not apply its formula to injection into groundwater. Chapter I lists injection of effluents into groundwater as instance (f). For instances (d) to (f), compensation has an immediate-relief part and a long-term remediation part, decided on detailed investigation by expert institutions with a remediation plan supervised by the SPCB, CPCB and the experts; the PI x N x R x S x LF formula covers instances (a) to (c). The KSPCB's order of 10 October 2025 applied the formula to 168 days of injection (Rs 50,40,000 with a 1.5 repeat multiplier) and declared payment to be in full satisfaction of the Unit's liability for the injection, without addressing the groundwater results or GSDA's call for a hydrogeological investigation. Using the formula for the injection, as instructed, would adopt the KSPCB's figure as the measure of a harm whose extent nobody yet knows.
instrument: CPCB Methodology for Assessing Environmental Compensation and Action Plan to Utilize the Fund (2019)
recommendation: Do not plead the formula for the borewell injection. Plead immediate relief (drinking water, health monitoring) and a direction that the Unit fund a hydrogeological investigation by an expert institution, with remediation costed on its result. Treat the Rs 50,40,000 as a payment on account, never a ceiling, and resist the full-satisfaction clause (FL-0008). The catalog marks the methodology 'verify': confirm the instances and clauses against the CPCB text before any court use (FL-0010).
